image_description: A close-up, low-resolution image of a yellow and black marine fish, identified as a Rock Beauty (Holocanthus tricolor). The fish has a distinct black anterior head and face, transitioning to a bright yellow body and tail. There is a blueish hue around the eye and on the dorsal/anal fins. The background is dark and blurry, resembling a reef environment. At the bottom left, there is illegible white text that appears to be a watermark or artifact.

The transition from black head to yellow body is too gradual and soft, lacking the crisp boundary typically seen in Holocanthus tricolor.
